azure.review.acr.selected_image_secret_i.title: Selected immutable ACR images have no detected secrets
azure.review.acr.selected_image_secret_i.description: Inspect only explicitly selected immutable ACR images with both offline detectors after binding native registry identity, repository pull authorization and content digests.
azure.review.acr.selected_image_secret_i.remediation: Remove exposed credential literals from image build inputs and layers, rebuild the image, and rotate confirmed exposed credentials.
azure.review.acr.selected_image_secret_i.purpose: Only selected supported observed manifest/config/layer content is inspected; no running workload, historical or credential-validity conclusion.
azure.review.acr.selected_image_secret_i.missing_observation: The selected ACR image could not be completely read, bound and scanned with both offline detectors.
azure.review.acr.selected_image_secret_i.pass_observation: Both offline detectors completed without detecting a supported secret in the selected immutable ACR image.
azure.review.acr.selected_image_secret_i.fail_observation: A likely secret was detected in a selected immutable ACR image. The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.
